title: Tesla Driver Crashes While Using Full Self-Driving
excerpt: A Tesla driver admitted to being asleep and using driver assist during a highway crash, prompting a warning from the California Highway Patrol.
body_html:
A Tesla driver crashed into California Highway Patrol vehicles while allegedly asleep and utilizing the vehicle's driver-assist technology. Video footage released by the highway patrol shows the Tesla speeding prior to the collision.

Following the incident, the California Highway Patrol issued a warning to the public. Authorities emphasized that despite the name, full self-driving systems are not fully autonomous. Officials reminded the public that the technology does not relieve operators of their legal responsibility to safely control their vehicles at all times.
